presets.title: Cross-bank ring around a case
presets.why: The case spanning the most banks: every account it concerns, the transfers touching them and the bank each sits at. No single bank can see this picture.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(a:Account)
WITH c, collect(a) AS ring, collect(DISTINCT a.bank_id) AS banks
ORDER BY size(banks) DESC, size(ring) DESC LIMIT 1
UNWIND ring AS a
MATCH (c)-[r:CONCERNS]->(a)-[h:HELD_AT]->(bank:Bank)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[t:TRANSFERS]-(cp:Account)
WITH c, r, a, h, bank, collect([t, cp])[0..30] AS nb
UNWIND nb AS x
RETURN c, r, a, h, bank, x[0] AS transfer, x[1] AS counterparty

presets.title: PageRank hubs and who feeds them
presets.why: algo.pageRank over the TRANSFERS graph finds where money pools; each of the top six hubs is drawn with up to 30 of its transfers (node size = PageRank score).
presets.cypher:
CALL algo.pageRank('Account', 'TRANSFERS') YIELD node, score
WITH node, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 6
MATCH (node)-[t:TRANSFERS]-(cp:Account)
WITH node, score, collect([t, cp])[0..30] AS nb
UNWIND nb AS x
RETURN node, score, x[0] AS transfer, x[1] AS counterparty

presets.title: Label-propagation communities
presets.why: algo.labelPropagation splits the transfer graph into communities; the six largest small ones (4-40 accounts) are candidate rings, coloured by community.
presets.cypher:
CALL algo.labelPropagation({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS'],
                            maxIterations:10}) YIELD node, communityId
WITH communityId, collect(node) AS members
WHERE size(members) >= 4 AND size(members) <= 40
WITH communityId, members ORDER BY size(members) DESC LIMIT 6
UNWIND members AS a
MATCH (a)-[f:FLOWS]->(b:Account) WHERE b IN members
RETURN a, communityId AS community, f, b

presets.title: Connected component around a suspect
presets.why: algo.wcc partitions every account into islands; this is the largest island (under 250 accounts) that contains an account an alert escalated to a case.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (:Alert {status:'case'})-[:RAISED_FOR]->(s:Account)
WITH collect(DISTINCT s.id) AS suspects
CALL algo.wcc({nodeLabels:['Account'], relationshipTypes:['TRANSFERS']})
YIELD node, componentId
WITH suspects, componentId, collect(node) AS members
WHERE size(members) <= 250 AND any(m IN members WHERE m.id IN suspects)
WITH members ORDER BY size(members) DESC LIMIT 1
UNWIND members AS a
MATCH (a)-[f:FLOWS]->(b:Account)
RETURN a, f, b

presets.title: Shortest money paths across banks
presets.why: algo.SPpaths returns the k shortest directed TRANSFERS paths between two accounts at different banks with no shortcut; every hop is a real transaction, with the bank and owner of each account on the route.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (s:Account)-[:TRANSFERS]->(:Account)-[:TRANSFERS]->(:Account)-[:TRANSFERS]->(d:Account)
WHERE s.bank_id <> d.bank_id AND s <> d AND NOT (s)-[:TRANSFERS]->(d)
  AND NOT (s)-[:TRANSFERS]->(:Account)-[:TRANSFERS]->(d)
WITH s, d LIMIT 1
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode:s, targetNode:d, relTypes:['TRANSFERS'],
                   maxLen:4, pathCount:6, relDirection:'outgoing'})
YIELD path, pathWeight
UNWIND nodes(path) AS n
MATCH (n)-[h:HELD_AT]->(bank:Bank)
OPTIONAL MATCH (owner)-[ow:OWNS]->(n)
RETURN path, pathWeight AS hops, h, bank, ow, owner

presets.title: Phonetic name search (Double Metaphone)
presets.why: Full-text index with Double Metaphone phonetic matching: a misspelt 'Kenji Aly' still finds every Kenji Ali, and the accounts they hold across five banks.
presets.cypher:
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Person', 'Kenji Aly') YIELD node, score
WITH node, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 12
MATCH (node)-[o:OWNS]->(a:Account)-[h:HELD_AT]->(bank:Bank)
RETURN node, score, o, a, h, bank

presets.title: Behaviour twins (vector KNN, HNSW)
presets.why: db.idx.vector.queryNodes over 16-dim behaviour embeddings finds accounts that move money like a case seed, wherever they bank. No shared edge needed.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (c:Case)-[:CONCERNS]->(seed:Account)
WITH seed ORDER BY seed.in_deg + seed.out_deg DESC LIMIT 1
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Account', 'behavior_vec', 20, seed.behavior_vec)
YIELD node, score
MATCH (node)-[h:HELD_AT]->(bank:Bank)
RETURN node, score AS distance, h, bank

presets.title: Shared identity across banks
presets.why: Accounts at different banks that share a device, IP or address: the cross-bank identity collisions only a consortium graph can surface.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (a:Account)-[u:USES_DEVICE|USES_IP|REGISTERED_AT]->(x)
      <-[v:USES_DEVICE|USES_IP|REGISTERED_AT]-(b:Account)
WHERE a.bank_id <> b.bank_id AND id(a) < id(b)
RETURN a, u, x, v, b LIMIT 200

presets.title: Agent work graph: alert to case to claim
presets.why: The multi-agent pipeline lives in the graph: alerts raised on accounts, cases opened from them, and the claims investigators attached.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (c:Case)-[o:OPENED_FROM]->(al:Alert)-[r:RAISED_FOR]->(a:Account)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[h:HAS_CLAIM]->(cl:Claim)
RETURN c, o, al, r, a, h, cl LIMIT 400

presets.title: Case provenance DAG
presets.why: Every SAR sentence cites claims or evidence, every claim is supported by evidence with a recorded origin: the auditable chain behind a filing, in one case graph.
presets.cypher:
MATCH (k:Case)-[hs:HAS_SAR]->(s:SAR {state:'active'})-[ct:CONTAINS]->(se:Sentence)-[ci:CITES]->(x)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[sb:SUPPORTED_BY]->(e:Evidence)
OPTIONAL MATCH (x)-[ab:ABOUT]->(a:Account)
RETURN k, hs, s, ct, se, ci, x, sb, e, ab, a LIMIT 500

presets.title: Typology knowledge graph
presets.why: The FATF-sourced typology KB the agents retrieve from: typologies, their indicators and the source chunks (full-text indexed with English stemming).

presets.title: Procedural memory the agents learned
presets.why: Investigation procedures the Archivist distilled from closed cases, stored as ordered STEP chains it replays on similar cases.
